name: Server Status & Power
description: Monitor CPU, RAM, SMART drive health, disk space, Conky-like system stats, service states, power off/reboot, and boot service autostart

commands.sys_info_cmd: echo '===HOST==='; hostname; uname -r; echo '===CPU==='; lscpu | grep -E 'Model name|CPU\(s\):'; echo '===LOAD==='; cat /proc/loadavg; echo '===MEM==='; free -m; echo '===UPTIME==='; uptime; echo '===NET==='; ip -brief addr
commands.enable_boot_service_sudo:
mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && (cp ./debian-server-manager /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager 2>/dev/null || cp /proc/$(pgrep -f main 2>/dev/null | head -n1)/exe /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager 2>/dev/null || (which go >/dev/null && go build -o /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager main.go) || cp "$0" /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager) && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager && printf '[Unit]
Description=Debian Server Manager Web App
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=%s
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager
Restart=always
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' "$(pwd)" > /etc/systemd/system/debian-server-manager.service && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable debian-server-manager
commands.disable_boot_service_sudo: systemctl disable debian-server-manager || true && rm -f /etc/systemd/system/debian-server-manager.service /usr/local/bin/debian-server-manager && systemctl daemon-reload
